source: NCERT Class VII, Curiosity: Textbook of Science, Ch. 5.

sections.heading: 1. Changes Around Us
points: Changes happen all around us; they are grouped as **physical** or **chemical**.
**Physical change** — only appearance/state changes; **no new substance**; usually **reversible**.
**Chemical change** — a **new substance** is formed; usually **irreversible**.

sections.heading: 2. Physical Changes
points: Examples: **melting ice, boiling/freezing water, dissolving sugar/salt, tearing paper, stretching a rubber band, breaking glass**.
The substance stays the **same** chemically; often the change can be **reversed**.
Change of **state** (solid↔liquid↔gas) is physical.

sections.heading: 3. Chemical Changes
points: Examples: **burning (paper, wood, candle), cooking, rusting of iron, souring of milk (curd), digestion, ripening of fruit, photosynthesis**.
Signs of a chemical change: **new substance, change of colour/smell, evolution of gas, heat/light given out or absorbed**.
**Rusting** (iron + oxygen + moisture → rust) and **burning of magnesium** (→ white magnesium oxide) are chemical changes.

sections.heading: 4. Reversible and Irreversible
points: Many **physical** changes are **reversible** (ice ↔ water).
Most **chemical** changes are **irreversible** (a burnt paper cannot become paper again).
**Crystallisation** (getting pure crystals from a solution) is a useful **physical** change.

sections.heading: 5. High-Yield One-Liners (Last-Minute Recall)
points: Physical change = no new substance, usually reversible (melting, dissolving, tearing).
Chemical change = new substance, usually irreversible (burning, rusting, cooking, curdling).
Signs of chemical change: new substance, colour/smell change, gas, heat/light.
Rusting needs iron + oxygen + moisture; magnesium burns to white magnesium oxide.
Crystallisation = physical change (purification).

sections.heading: 6. Common Traps (Watch Out)
points: A change forming a **new substance** (burning/rusting/cooking) is **chemical**.
Change of **state** (ice→water→steam) is **physical**.
**Souring of milk** and **rusting** are **chemical** (irreversible).
**Crystallisation** is a **physical** change.
